E1.name: Built
E1.means: the software runs and its own tests pass; whether the method helps is not tested

E2.means: the measuring recovers known answers planted in simulated people; whether the method helps is not tested

E3.name: Tested in simulation
E3.means: registered tests of whether the method helps, on simulated people or agents

E4.name: Tested on recorded data
E4.means: registered tests on real recorded data, not on people using RSOS

E5.name: Tested with people using RSOS
E5.means: a registered study with people using RSOS
